answer: The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A dune of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
